events.text: Comment deadline on Treasury's proposed GENIUS Act stablecoin rules.
events.detail: Treasury's proposal sets how the GENIUS Act's limits on issuing, offering and selling payment stablecoins in the U.S. would work. Final rules come later.

events.text: ALCS Game 6: Cleveland Guardians at Tampa Bay Rays, 8:00 p.m. ET on TBS; Rays lead 3-2 and can clinch the AL pennant.
events.detail: Per MLB’s postseason schedule; Game 7, if needed, is Tuesday, Oct. 20, at 8:00 p.m. ET at Tropicana Field. The winner faces the Milwaukee Brewers in the World Series.

events.text: Alberta votes on whether to start the legal process toward a future referendum on leaving Canada; polls close 10 p.m. ET.
events.detail: Per AP: the vote is not a direct independence referendum. Polls are open 9 a.m. to 8 p.m. local time (11 a.m. to 10 p.m. ET). More than 1.35 million Albertans, 43% of eligible voters, voted early. Prime Minister Mark Carney campaigned for a decisive "no"; Premier Danielle Smith called the vote but opposes independence.

events.text: Comment deadline on the SEC's proposed Regulation Crypto Assets.
events.detail: The proposal would add a safe harbor under which some crypto assets would not be treated as investment contracts under securities law. The SEC must still vote on a final rule.
